logp.method_description: Water saturated octanol (WSO) and octanol-saturated water (OSW) were prepared using 0.05 M aqueous NaCl solution (to suppress hydrolysis of the chlorido complexes) and analytical grade octanol. Mix aliquots of stock solutions of iridium complexes 3 and 6 in OSW and WSO in equal volume and shaken in an IKA Vibrax VXC basic shaker for 4 h at 500 g/min, 298 K, to allow partition at room temperature. The aqueous layer was attentively separated from the octanol layer for iridium analysis. Partition coefficients of metal complexes were calculated using the equation log P = log ([M]WSO/[M]OSW), where [M]WSO was obtained by subtraction of the metal content of the aqueous layer after partition from the metal content of the aqueous layer before partition.
